location.site_note: Existing Google data center campus on the Tennessee Valley Authority's retired Widows Creek coal plant site; expansion parcel/building footprint not disclosed in public sources reviewed on 2026-08-11.

status_as_of_cutoff: announced: Google announced on 2026-06-15 a $1.5 billion investment across 2026 and 2027 to expand its Jackson County, Alabama data center campus. Public county agendas reviewed through the 2026-08-10 Jackson County Commission meeting did not show a project-specific permit, rezoning, site-plan, construction, energization, or commissioning action; therefore this refresh does not classify the expansion as locally approved, under construction, energized, or live.
evidence_grade: B: Google primary announcement confirms the investment, timing window, site context, power-cost commitment, and community programs; Jackson County agenda postings provide negative local-government evidence through 2026-08-10; capacity_mw remains unverified because published MW figures describe generation or grid supply, not the expansion's data-center capacity.

status_history.status_as_of_cutoff: A 2026 trade report describes a $1.5 billion Jackson County expansion, but no project-specific 2026 county/city permit, parcel, construction, energization, or commissioning record was located. The county's accessible hazard-mitigation plan confirms an existing Google facility, not the new expansion.
